Broker owns translation and submission contract.
Broker owns ingestion contract; external broker owns raw truth.
Target ledger authority owns interface acceptance.
Target position authority owns interface acceptance.
Market Data Authority owns market-state dependency.
Broker owns adapter and capability governance.
Broker owns anomaly case file transfer contract.
Broker owns read-only audit surface over its message history.
